segments.mil3.6.10:1.4: “Nanu, bhante nāgasena, cittena sarati no satiyā”ti?
segments.mil3.6.10:1.5: “Abhijānāsi nu, tvaṃ mahārāja, kiñcideva karaṇīyaṃ katvā pamuṭṭhan”ti?
segments.mil3.6.10:1.7: “Kiṃ nu kho, tvaṃ mahārāja, tasmiṃ samaye acittako ahosī”ti?
segments.mil3.6.10:1.8: “Na hi, bhante, sati tasmiṃ samaye nāhosī”ti.
